It was the final round of the Mind Champions Challenge - a visually impaired tournament organized by ChessBase India with Lions Club and Phoenix Marketcity. Two amazing players faced off against each other. Rohit Jadhav, the top seed of the event and also the one on 5.0/5 and Ved Phaur on 4.5/5. The one who would win this game would become the champion! Check out the game along with commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
